title: Moabi wa Botlhale jo bo sa Feleng
intro: Motho yo o tlotlegang, yo o neng a itsege ka temogo ya gagwe e e tseneletseng le kgakololo ya gagwe e e botlhale, o kile a naya kgakololo e e fetang dikokomana. Mafoko a bone, a a kwadilweng mo lokwalong lo lo boitshepo, a kaela batho ka bongwe go ya kwa tebogong, bopelotelele, le boitshwaro jo bo siameng.
clues: Ke ne ke segofaditswe ka botlhale, e seng ka boporofeti.
Ke ne ka gakolola ngwanake ka boleo jo bogolo go gaisa: go amanya balekane le Allah.
Ke ne ke ruta ka bokete jwa ditiro, tota le boleng jwa peo ya mosetareta, le kafa Allah a tla e ntshang ka gone.
Ke ne ke gatelela go leboga Allah le batsadi ba motho, ke amogela mathata a go godisa ngwana.
Kgakololo ya me e ne e akaretsa go tlhoma thapelo, go laela molemo, go thibela bosula le go itshokela ka bopelotelele se se diragalelang motho.
Kgaolo nngwe mo Quran e bidiwa ka nna, e na le dithuto tsa me le dithuto tse ke neng ka di abelana.

outcome.label: Botso
options: Batho ba gagwe ba ne ba nyelediwa
Botlhale jwa gagwe bo ne jwa nna mokaedi
O ne a tlhatlosediwa kwa magodimong
O ne a newa khumo e ntsi thata
outcome.answer: Botlhale jwa gagwe bo ne jwa nna mokaedi

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
